title: Control Plane morning roundup - Jun 16 2026
content:
Attendees: Sofia Patel (Recorder), Miguel Ortiz, Rina Zhao, Tom Benson, Lina Ahmed, oncall: Miguel

Purpose: This is a compact morning roundup capturing the platform-controlplane team's sync: quick highlights, current schedule, ongoing incidents, recent deploys affecting routing/auth/quotas, and concrete action items for the next 72 hours. Intention is a readable single-document source for async updates and handoffs to SRE and solutions-engineering.

1) Quick highlights / wins
- Deployed the routing hotfix (hotfix-rt-06-15) to us-west-2; micro-benchmarks show median route selection latency down ~12% for 512-token traces. (PR: 2847)
- KV cache instrumentation added to canaries; we now emit prefix-hit-ratio with per-model labels (helps explain token cost anomalies).
- Quota throttle escalation path documented in Confluence; added a runbook snippet for quota backoff policy.

2) Production incidents / ongoing investigations
- INF-4123 (quota throttling regression): Since the 2026-06-14 deploy, a subset of tenant traffic experienced aggressive 429s when burst patterns hit a new route split. Symptom: clients hit quota window earlier, requests fell back to lower-capacity pools instead of graceful defer. Current status: investigation in progress. Root-candidate: race in quota-window-update logic when routing splits are applied concurrently with quota-schema update.
  - Observations: Spike in rb-window-update errors from allocator between 04:00-04:12 UTC on 2026-06-15.
  - Temporary mitigation: rolled out control-plane config that forces sequential quota-schema commits for affected orgs (rolled back on 06-16 02:00 UTC after partial fix).
  - Next step: Rina to reproduce the schema race locally using the test harness (ticket INF-4123).

- INF-4189 (auth token refresh mismatch): Some tokens issued by the delegated auth proxy expired earlier than expected for long-lived streams. Likely cause: clock skew between auth-proxy and controlplane token-mint service in a subset of dedicated nodes. Status: minor, no customer-facing error reported but unit tests flaked.
  - Action: Tom to add syncing and health-check on token-mint endpoints; schedule a rolling restart for proxies hugging older kernel versions.

3) Recent deploys and canary feedback
- Routing hotfix-rt-06-15: Canary passed in us-west-2 and eu-central-1; saw improved route decision latencies for multi-model splits. Canary note: one canary host reported higher KV-cache misses—linked to outdated kernel image; we excluded that host from the canary after triage.
- Quota service patch (qsvc-06-14): Deployed to staging only. Load test showed a 7% regression in quota-eval latency under synthetic bursting. Need to profile slow path. Miguel to run flamegraph comparison.

4) Metrics and SLO check
- Median controlplane API latency (p50) this week: 38ms (target 40ms).
- 95th percentile latency: 210ms (target 200ms) — small exceedance, driven by a tail in quota-eval RPCs.
- Error budget consumed: ~4.2% of daily window (within alert threshold but trending up).
- Quota 429 rate: baseline 0.03% -> spiked to 0.7% during INF-4123.

5) Blockers and risks
- Race in quota commit flow (INF-4123) blocking full rollout of new quota windowing feature. Risk: If not fixed, could delay Dedicated customers' bandwidth bump planned for next sprint.
- Token skew issue (INF-4189) may cause intermittent stream restarts under high variance clocks; needs proactive remediation to avoid customer flakiness on long-lived streams.
- Capacity planning note: Upcoming private deployment in APAC next month — ensure routing policy includes region-aware fallback before fleet expansion.

6) Action items (owner, due)
- Rina Zhao: Reproduce quota-schema race in local harness, attach deterministic reproducer (INF-4123). Due: 2026-06-18.
- Miguel Ortiz (oncall): Generate flamegraphs comparing qsvc-06-14 vs qsvc-05-30 under burst load; post findings to ticket. Due: 2026-06-17 EOD.
- Tom Benson: Add token-mint health probe and schedule rolling restart for proxies on kernel <5.15 nodes. Due: 2026-06-18.
- Lina Ahmed: Update Canaries dashboard with per-host KV-cache miss annotation; add alert when miss-ratio > 15% sustained for 5m. Due: 2026-06-19.
- Sofia Patel: Draft rollout plan for quota-window feature that includes a staged config migration and a rollback knob. Due: 2026-06-20.

7) Decisions made
- Hold the global rollout of quota-window feature until reproducible fix for INF-4123 is validated on staging and in a limited canary group (10% of orgs).
- Any canary host running kernel <5.15 will be excluded from KV-cache-sensitive canaries until patched.

8) Notes for cross-team coordination
- SRE: Please prioritize a short-lived elevated log level for allocator between 03:50-04:30 UTC to capture rb-window-update failures if they reoccur. Contact: Miguel.
- Solutions-Eng: Expect limited capacity for tenants scheduled for quota increase next sprint until INF-4123 is resolved. Lina will notify impacted customers.
- Observability: Recommend adding a synthetic test that hits quota-eval codepath with burst-y traffic to catch future regressions automatically.

9) Follow-ups / next meeting
- Quick sync tomorrow 07:30 PT (Sofia leading) to review reproducer and flamegraphs. If a reproducer is available, schedule a longer debug session with allocator/quotas owners.
- Add INF-4123 and INF-4189 to the agenda for Wednesday platform retro.

Appendix: useful links and snippets
- Quick grep for the suspect commit: git log --oneline --graph --grep=quota-window --since=\"2026-06-10\"
- Small snippet to collect allocator window events: node_agent/bin/collector --events rb-window-update --since 2026-06-14T03:40Z > /tmp/allocator-window.log

Notes to self (informal):
- Keep the morning roundup short; long deep-dive moved to a separate debug doc (linked in INF tickets).
- Remember to ping the PM owning Dedicated quota ramps — they need visibility for customer conversations.

End of roundup.
